answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in delta, checked in quill, and oasis publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2444 identities would post 1376 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
